facts.text: Listen up, X-Force. Dinner is mandatory and so is wearing pants. Peter, that means you.
facts.why: Not found among Wade's lines in any source I opened. It is printed in quote marks as dialogue. As a note Wade might write it is true to Peter, who has no powers and joins X-Force after seeing an ad.
facts.fix: Listen up, X-Force. Dinner is mandatory and so is wearing pants. Peter, that means you.

facts.text: Serve the snacks when X-Force jumps out of the plane.
facts.why: In the transcript Domino says they did not jump out of the plane because of a light breeze, so the X-Force drop is a jump from a plane.
facts.fix: Serve the snacks when X-Force parachutes in to hit the convoy.

facts.text: Russell's order at the Ice Box. Big trouble follows.
facts.why: The Ice Box is the mutant prison where Russell is taken and Cable attacks. No source shows Russell ordering mac and cheese or any food there.
facts.fix: Comfort food for Russell. Big trouble follows.

vibe.verdict: The right prison cafeteria and the key X-Force jokes, but a lot of the food has no film hook.
